prose: Short note from feed metadata only: The Hacker News reports that researchers were paid a $5,000 bounty for disclosing to OpenAI the bug behind the malicious ChatGPT share link that could run attacker code in the logged-in session of anyone who opened it - the same account-takeover chain detailed in Parameter's write-up (see today's main summary, d6d8b417fe77). The fetched page content did not match the story, so this rests on the feed description alone.
highlights: $5,000 bounty paid for the ChatGPT share-link code-execution bug, per The Hacker News
Same vulnerability chain as the Parameter write-up summarized today (d6d8b417fe77)
Bounty size is the news hook - modest for a one-click account takeover
